# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 stable release** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers Skia m151 with faster managed color, text, and shaping paths. It adds .NET 11 WebAssembly native assets, restores CPU raster shader compatibility, and fixes a native image-decoding resource leak.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 151 and incorporates subsequent upstream bug-fix and stability syncs. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))
- **CPU raster shader compatibility restored** — Restores the legacy shader-context configuration needed to avoid a CPU raster regression. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **Span-based color parsing** — SKColor hex parsing adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and avoids unnecessary parsing overhead. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Encoded-image subset resources released** — SKImage.FromEncodedData with a subset rectangle no longer leaks its native resource. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly assets** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and exception handling support for .NET 11 WebAssembly applications. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower-allocation managed operations** — Color conversion, premultiplication, text shaping, tags, and encoded text paths avoid repeated native calls or transient allocations. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **Faster HarfBuzz text shaping** — HarfBuzzSharp avoids allocations when adding UTF-8 strings and parsing tags. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Improves HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 buffer population and tag parsing to eliminate recurring allocations.
